title: Reset Failed Locomotion Environments
summary: Reset logic should identify why an episode ended before replacing state.

frames: Right-handed robot base x forward/y left/z up; terrain positions/origins in one world frame

units.values: Positions and terrain lengths use meters; velocities m/s; angular rates rad/s; contact forces N; durations seconds; normalized action and unit-gravity coordinates are dimensionless. Penalty terms retain the individual units stated in the contract.

physical_contract.axes: Environment, time, body-contact and controller-channel axes are defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each environment is independent. Supplied episode counters and reset flags refer to the same control transition. Terrain update occurs on subsequent resets; no wall-clock scheduling or simulator action is performed.
physical_contract.batching: Environment, time, body-contact and controller-channel axes are defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Bounded component associated with Learning to Walk in Minutes. Released reward/termination/curriculum formulas are isolated from full PPO training, physics, command randomization and hardware transfer. Supplied initialization states and recorded draws make replay deterministic.
